sources.author: Zdrgon
patch_list: Stops banner, interstitial and app-open ads from loading (AppLovin MAX). Rewarded ads for hints are left working.

sources.label: Patches for the Wykop.pl app, for use with Morphe
sources.author: HagiaHaya
patch_list: Allows signing in with Google and receiving notifications by using MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services.
Stops banner, interstitial and app-open ads from loading (AppLovin MAX). Rewarded ads for hints are left working.
Enables the game's built-in unlimited hints mode, so using a hint never lowers the hint balance. arm64-v8a devices only.
